thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — elevated error rate detected for inference-gateway in us-west-2, auto-page. Alert group: inference-5xx-spike. Paging on-call.

Sarah L.: I'm on-call and taking this. Can someone summarize customer impact quickly? @MikeR any recent deploys or config pushes?

Mike R.: pulling alerts: 5xx rate increased ~22% across chat and embedding routes. Tail latency up. No model deploys in last 8h, but I see a canary rollout to batching-combinator ~35m ago from CI. @Julia can you confirm rollout status?

Julia (SRE): confirming. Canary for batching-combinator v1.7 started at 1892001200 (~35m). Automated rollout script bumped it to ~70% due to a flag parse bug. Pausing and initiating rollback to v1.6. ETA ~3m.

incident-bot: rollback initiated by Julia (SRE) at 1892001405. Target: batching-combinator. Status: in-progress.

Deepak: customer impact: four customers experienced transient errors and retry storms, one fintech customer reported repeated embed failures. No data exfiltration. Queue times increased, sessions timed out.

Tina: node logs show KV-store evictions then OOMs on gateway workers: 
```
2026-06-20T09:12:34Z worker-2 gateway: WARN kv_store: evicted 142 pages, current_entries=1250000 max_entries=1048576
2026-06-20T09:12:37Z worker-2 gateway: CRIT process: oom_kill (rss 2.1G > limit 1.8G)
2026-06-20T09:12:38Z worker-2 gateway: ERROR http: upstream 502 Bad Gateway
```

Ben: eviction + OOM pattern => cache pressure. If combinator concatenates inputs across requests, we'd see prefix growth. Any long prefixes in request logs?

Mike R.: digging into request logs, found concatenated contexts with huge prefix lengths. Examples: 
```
req=0xabc prefix_tokens=10000 prompt_tokens=512
req=0xdef prefix_tokens=2048 prompt_tokens=128
req=0xghi prefix_tokens=8192 prompt_tokens=256
```
Not normal.

Sarah L.: Hypotheses (tracked in-thread):
- H1: batching-combinator v1.7 concatenates contexts across requests -> KV growth -> OOMs -> 5xxs. Owner: Mike R.
- H2: autoscaler misconfig allowed frontend to scale faster than backends, amplifying failures. Owner: Julia (SRE).
- H3: runtime memory regression from recent kernel selector experiments. Owner: Deepak.

Julia (SRE): rollback completed at 1892001470; v1.6 restored. Cleaning flags now. Early telemetry: nodes that finished rollback still show elevated KV counts but new errors dropped on those hosts.

deploy-bot: deploy finished for service=batching-combinator version=v1.6 user=Julia at 1892001470.

Deepak: starting heap profile on a reproduced gateway pod and uploading artifacts: https://internal-storage/heap/1892001450/dump (temp link).

Ben: scoped mitigation: add hard prefix-token upper bound at gateway to reject >4096 tokens with 400, and a short-term cache-trim on overflow. Owner: Ben for gateway patch; Julia for cache trim.

Sarah L.: emergency hotfix approved. Prefer user-visible 400 instead of letting OOMs cascade.

Ben: pushing gateway hotfix now (cap=4096). Rolling 30% -> 100% if metrics look good. Patch snippet: 
```
if (prefix_tokens > 4096) {
  return httpError(400, "prefix too long: reduce context")
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy started for service=inference-gateway patch=cap-prefix-4096 user=Ben at 1892001501. Rolling to 30%.

Mike R.: opened a staging repro that simulates the combinator and shows cross-request concatenation when parallel batches interleave. PR #4185 adds a guard to avoid cross-request concat and tests: https://git.internal/r/redwood/4185

Tina: telemetry: after rollback error rate dropped 22% -> 11%. After gateway cap to 4096 at 1892001520 on 30% nodes, patched nodes show 5xx ~2% and OOMs stopped on those hosts.

Deepak: heap dump analysis shows many oversized KV entries whose keys match combined contexts. This aligns with H1. Runtime kernel flags show only CI canary changes, no prod runtime changes — H3 low probability.

Julia (SRE): autoscaler logs show a noisy metric event at 1892001180 that caused ghost-scaling; frontend overshot backends. We've patched the scale-policy to ignore <1m spikes. H2 is a contributing factor.

Sarah L.: Hypothesis status updates:
- H1: confirmed — root cause is batching-combinator v1.7 concatenation bug leading to unbounded prefixes and KV growth. Evidence: logs, heap dumps, parity between v1.7 hosts and KV counts. Confirmed at 1892001580. Owner: Mike R.
- H2: contributing factor — autoscaler amplified the impact. Owner: Julia (SRE).
- H3: ruled out. Owner: Deepak.

Action items (in-thread):
- A1: keep hotfix in place and monitor for 30m. Owner: Ben. (status: rolling)
- A2: fully revert v1.7 and block subsequent rollouts until patch validated. Owner: Julia (SRE). (status: done)
- A3: add integration test for batching-combinator to prevent cross-request concat. Owner: Mike R. (PR #4185).
- A4: tighten autoscaler heuristics to ignore sub-1m spikes. Owner: Julia (SRE).
- A5: collect heap dumps, rollout logs, and timeline into incident doc. Owner: Deepak & Sarah L.

Ben: hotfix reached 100% at 1892001625. No OOMs since full roll; 5xxs baseline returned. Rollback plan: if cap breaks legitimate long-context users, revert and deploy smarter trimming instead. Rollback plan documented in PR.

Mike R.: PR #4185 merged to staging with tests. Will open prod PR after postmortem. Also adding canary ramp script validation to runbook.

Deepak: artifacts uploaded: https://internal-storage/incidents/1892001200/artifacts (heap dumps, logs, timeline). Customer comms drafted and legal-approved. No customer data loss.

Julia (SRE): autoscaler fix deployed at 1892001700. Trimmed KV caches on affected nodes via internal API: POST /internal/cache/trim?target=20 completed.

incident-bot: severity downgraded to P2 at 1892001710 — mitigations active, impact reduced.

Sarah L.: scheduling postmortem for 2026-06-21 16:00 UTC. Invite includes action owners. Please update this thread with final timestamps and confirm done statuses before meeting.

Ben: gateway cap will remain for 24h as protective measure; will replace with graceful truncation after tests. Tracking issue GH-2310.

Mike R.: will follow up with canary rollout script fixes and a short summary in the postmortem doc.

Tina: dashboards show stable tail latency and KV counts returning to normal. Monitoring continuing.

Sarah L.: thanks all. Root cause documented; mitigations in place; postmortem follow-up assigned. Re-open thread if anything recurs. :clap: 

incident-bot: Incident moved to resolved->monitoring at 1892001800. Thread will remain editable for RCA notes and artifacts.
